messages:
maria: quick q — who can approve PR #8457? It modifies infra/shared-auth/* and adds a line to CODEOWNERS to include `@security/team` and `@infra/owners`. Wanted to merge before EOD if possible. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8457

alex: my read — that path falls under infra and auth libs. CODEOWNERS change means both infra and auth need to be ok. But small change, maybe infra can proxy-approve if auth is busy. :thinking:

sam: fyi I'm the listed owner in CODEOWNERS but on PTO today. I can proxy until 5pm PT from phone if needed. Otherwise we should get infra-team or eng-platform to OK.

katie: I'm on rotation but OOO in afternoon. jamal is my backup — @jamal can you take a quick look at the auth config?

jamal: yep I can review, will do a quick pass now. If it's only docs/config lines should be fine. If it touches runtime creds let's escalate to security.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, lint). staging deploy queued.

maria: thanks — PR is just a CODEOWNERS entry + small default config tweak (no creds). added a short changelog. pinging @eng-platform for merge rules: can infra merge when both listed owners include a team alias or do we need explicit individual approvals?

alex: eng-platform here: if CODEOWNERS references team aliases (e.g., @infra/owners, @auth/owners) then any member of those teams can approve. If the PR also touches critical runtime we require an explicit 'security' approval. Since deploy-bot shows no e2e fails, i'd be comfortable with jamal + one infra approver.

sam: tagging @infra_oncall — can someone click approve so we can merge before EOD?

maria: ok jamal + one infra approver works. jamal, let me know when you're done and i'll merge.

jamal: reviewed, lgtm. left one tiny nit about comment. @alex or @sam can you approve so maria can merge? :+1:

alex: approving now. lgtm. :rocket:

maria: merged. thanks all!
